name: mb-io-e2e
description: BDD end-to-end test framework for mb.io (formerly trade.multibank.io) built on Playwright, playwright-bdd (Cucumber/Gherkin) and Allure.

scripts.e2e: npm ci && playwright install chromium firefox webkit && npm run test:all
scripts.test: npm run clean:results && bddgen && playwright test
scripts.test:desktop: npm run clean:results && bddgen && playwright test --project=desktop-chromium
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean:results && bddgen && playwright test --project=desktop-chromium --grep @smoke
scripts.test:api: npm run clean:results && bddgen && playwright test --project=desktop-chromium --grep @api
scripts.test:negative: npm run clean:results && bddgen && playwright test --grep @negative
scripts.test:navigation: npm run clean:results && bddgen && playwright test --grep @navigation
scripts.test:trading: npm run clean:results && bddgen && playwright test --grep @trading
scripts.test:content: npm run clean:results && bddgen && playwright test --grep @content
scripts.test:feature: npm run clean:results && bddgen && playwright test --grep @feature
scripts.test:all: npm run clean:results && bddgen && CROSS_BROWSER=1 playwright test
scripts.test:cross-browser: npm run clean:results && bddgen && CROSS_BROWSER=1 playwright test --project=desktop-firefox --project=desktop-webkit
scripts.report:allure: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
